node.title: Re^2: passing an array without a name to pop()
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If you check the [doc://prototype], [doc://pop] is ";+"

No, not anymore, this was an experiment added in Perl 5.14 and removed in 5.24; see "Array and hash container functions accept references" (aka "autoderef") in [doc://perlexperiment]. Its prototype has gone back to ;\@, like it was in 5.12 and below. The removal of the feature is why the "Experimental pop on scalar is now forbidden" error happens in the first place.
